top_signals.title: Global Bond Selloff Deepens; US, China Extend Trade Truce; Trump-Xi Summit
top_signals.summary: US equity futures fall and a global bond rout intensifies, pushing 30-year Treasury yield to the highest level since 2004. Oil rises as Iranian officials reportedly said the war with the US could expand. The US and China agree to extend their trade truce by two months ahead of Presidents Trump and Xi's state summit. Marko Papic of BCA Research joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the outlook for the latest bond selloff. Leland Miller of China Beige Book looks ahead to the Trump-Xi summit. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Turkey to Discuss Investor Paybacks in Fund Crisis Talks
top_signals.summary: Turkey’s economic authorities are holding two days of talks on how to repay investors in 131 investment funds being liquidated after a wave of redemption failures triggered turmoil in the country’s markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
